div.p: Typed wiring contracts. The seam graph is fixed; implementations only narrow the contract types on its edges.
validate() = subtyping over ports + operator support + calibration presence; failures name the compatible alternatives.

g.text: the data plane (narrow types live here)

text.tspan: named profiles are its tested rows; contract tests
verify declared ports, so metadata cannot lie
fails check 1 under the sample operator; under integrate
the matched filter fails check 2 regardless (it declares
operators = {sample}). validate() points at ppfact, or at
an image-level observation, as the compatible alternatives.
matched filter / speckle fitting: consumes FrameSet
(+ a null calibrated per post-processing impl)
context, and cost need NO per-kind wiring
run operator is in the intersection
of all chosen impls' declared sets
